name: ET4602 (AC Meter)
subtitle: Industrial - Energy Meter
description: A three-phase panel-mount AC energy meter with separate EB and DG kWh tracking, 2000VAC-isolated RS485, and phase-wise voltage/current/power breakdown for industrial and facility energy auditing.

hardware.value: Average VLL (RY, YB, BR), VLN (RN, YN, BN)
2000 VAC for 1 min between communication and other circuits

use_cases.title: Grid & Generator Energy Tracking
use_cases.desc: Monitors energy generation and consumption across grid and generator sources, providing a clear picture of power usage and source-wise contribution. This helps track generator performance, evaluate energy costs, and optimize power management across facilities.

use_cases.title: Industrial Power Monitoring
use_cases.desc: Provides continuous visibility into electrical parameters and power consumption across industrial equipment and facilities. It helps operators assess system performance, identify irregularities, and maintain efficient and reliable power distribution.

use_cases.title: Facility Energy Auditing
use_cases.desc: Collects and analyzes energy consumption data across different areas and equipment within a facility to identify usage patterns and potential inefficiencies. This helps organizations pinpoint energy-saving opportunities, reduce operating costs, and improve overall energy performance.
